articles.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
articles.description: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
articles.description: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
articles.description: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

articles.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
articles.description: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

articles.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
articles.description: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

articles.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

articles.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
articles.description: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

articles.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
articles.description: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

articles.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
articles.description: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

articles.title: Binance loses over $6 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
articles.description: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $77,000, though Binance's co-CEO said it would cover all losses.

articles.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
articles.description: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
articles.description: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

articles.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
articles.description: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

articles.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
articles.description: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
articles.description: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.description: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Only 1 in 5 Americans say the financial system is secure
Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
articles.description: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

articles.title: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, with Aave as launch partner
articles.description: The service uses perpetual futures quotes to update reference prices when traditional markets close.

articles.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
articles.description: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

articles.title: Walmart, Eli Lilly join growing pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.description: Five more companies have objected, bringing the total to 38 as a rival Canton venue prepares to launch with an issuer-sponsored stock under the SEC's innovation exemption.

articles.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
articles.description: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

articles.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
articles.description: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

articles.title: U.S. sanctions Russian nationals for laundering millions in crypto for North Korean IT workers
articles.description: Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas allegedly converted about $3.5 million and nearly $2 million in crypto, respectively, for North Korea.

articles.title: As $10 billion in bitcoin options near expiry, the tell is in the pricing
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 29, 2026
